zb.cli.intro: zb — recursive ZIP / zip-bomb variant generator
zb.cli.cmd.doctor: Probe backends, capabilities, and catalog coverage
zb.cli.cmd.verify: Independently verify an emitted artifact set
zb.cli.opt.variant: Variant id: bomb, quine, loopy, or fractal
zb.cli.opt.request: Structured zb.job/v1 request file (mutually exclusive with structure flags)
zb.cli.opt.quineName: Self-reference member path inside the archive
zb.cli.opt.attach: Attach a regular file as archivePath=sourcePath (repeatable)
zb.cli.opt.directory: Add an explicit empty directory entry (repeatable)
zb.cli.err.regularFile: Attachment must be a regular file, not a symbolic link: {path}
zb.cli.err.inputBudget: Attachment snapshots exceed the 8 MiB input budget
zb.cli.err.variant: Specify --variant bomb, quine, loopy, or fractal
zb.cli.err.quineOnly: Attachment and self-name options require --variant quine
zb.cli.err.singleArtifact: This output mode requires exactly one root artifact
zb.cli.err.requestConflict: Do not combine --request with --variant or attachment structure flags
zb.cli.err.jobSchema: Request file must use schema zb.job/v1
zb.cli.err.jobContainer: zb.job/v1 currently supports only container zip
zb.cli.err.jobGraphRequired: Variant {variant} requires a machine-indexed graph in the job
zb.cli.err.jobInput: Job input entries require node, archivePath, and a file or directoryEntry source
zb.cli.err.jobInputDuplicate: Duplicate job input for node {node} path {path}
zb.cli.err.jobOutput: Job outputs require node and a plain fileName
zb.cli.err.jobOutputName: Output fileName must be a plain file name: {name}
zb.cli.err.jobRelativePath: Job file sources must stay under the job directory: {path}
zb.cli.err.jobDirectoryPath: directoryEntry inputs require a trailing slash path: {path}
zb.cli.err.jobFilePath: file inputs cannot use a directory archive path: {path}
zb.cli.err.jobPayloadConflict: Job input collides with inline graph payload path: {path}
zb.cli.err.jobMissingArtifact: Generated artifact set is missing node {node}
